column1: # This file defines the steps and costs for the single-step lost load cost mode.
# The model will use these values to create a piecewise linear cost function for lost load.
#   - capacity_MWh: The size of the capacity block for this cost step
#   - cost_EUR_per_MWh: The cost of not serving this capacity block
# The last step should have a very large capacity_MWh to represent the final cost level.
